description: The 52 features compared. Ids are stable; labels are what splyt.fit/compare shows.

features.label: Sets, reps, weight
features.definition: Log sets, reps and weight.

features.label: Warm-up, drop & failure sets
features.definition: Tag sets as warm-up, drop set or failure set.

features.label: Supersets & circuits
features.definition: Group exercises into supersets or circuits.

features.label: Rest timer
features.definition: A rest timer between sets.

features.label: Plate calculator
features.definition: Shows which plates to load for a target weight.

features.label: Last time’s numbers
features.definition: Shows previous performance for an exercise, or prefills last time’s weights.

features.label: Personal records
features.definition: Detects and records personal records.

features.label: Exercise demos
features.definition: Video or animated demonstrations in the exercise library.

features.label: Grips & handles
features.definition: Logs grip, handle or attachment variations of one movement (e.g. rope vs bar) and tracks them separately under that movement.

features.label: Log by voice
features.definition: Log sets by speaking, inside the app (not just Siri dictation into a text field).

features.label: Lift + cardio in one session
features.definition: One session that combines lifting with cardio, a sport, sauna or similar.

features.label: GPS runs & rides
features.definition: GPS outdoor cardio tracking (run, walk, ride) with a route.

features.label: Sports beyond the gym
features.definition: Non-gym sports and activities (basketball, yoga, swimming…) as first-class workouts.

features.label: Works offline
features.definition: Works fully offline.

features.label: Apple Watch app
features.definition: Has an Apple Watch app.

features.label: Full logging on the Watch
features.definition: Log full strength workouts from the watch, not just view them.

features.label: Automatic rep counting
features.definition: Counts reps automatically from wrist motion.

features.label: Voice on the Watch
features.definition: Voice commands on the watch.

features.label: Watch face complications
features.definition: Watch face complications.

features.label: Garmin & other wearables
features.definition: Support for a wearable other than Apple Watch: Garmin, Wear OS or another. Wear OS-only support counts as yes; the note says which.

features.label: AI-built programs
features.definition: AI-generated or adaptive workout programs.

features.label: AI coach chat
features.definition: Chat with an AI coach about your training, inside the app.

features.label: Import from screenshots & notes
features.definition: Import workouts from screenshots, notes, text or social posts using AI.

features.label: Progression suggestions
features.definition: Automatic weight or rep progression suggestions.

features.label: Adapts to injuries
features.definition: Adapts workouts to injuries or limitations.

features.label: Saved workouts
features.definition: Saved workouts or routines.

features.label: Training calendar
features.definition: A training calendar for scheduling workouts ahead of time.

features.label: Proven splits
features.definition: Ready-made split programs (Push/Pull/Legs, Upper/Lower…).

features.label: Share workouts by link
features.definition: Share workouts or routines with other people by link.

features.label: Import from other apps
features.definition: Import workout history from Strong, Hevy or other apps.

features.label: Apple Health
features.definition: Syncs with Apple Health.

features.label: Strava
features.definition: Syncs with Strava.

features.label: Habits
features.definition: Habit tracking.

features.label: Sleep
features.definition: Sleep tracking or analysis.

features.label: Daily rings
features.definition: Daily activity or score rings of the app’s own.

features.label: Body weight & measurements
features.definition: Track body weight and measurements over time.

features.label: Progress photos
features.definition: Progress photos.

features.label: Recovery & sauna
features.definition: Recovery activities (sauna, cold plunge…) or recovery/strain scores.

features.label: Nutrition
features.definition: Nutrition or macro tracking in the same app.

features.label: Friends’ feed
features.definition: A feed of friends’ workouts.

features.label: Competitions
features.definition: Competitions or challenges between friends.

features.label: Follow a friend live
features.definition: Follow a friend’s workout while it is happening.

features.label: Reports for your trainer
features.definition: Share reports with your own trainer or coach, or a coach dashboard.

features.label: Progress charts
features.definition: Progress charts per exercise.

features.label: Muscle map
features.definition: Muscle heatmap or volume by muscle.

features.label: Weekly & monthly recaps
features.definition: Weekly or monthly recaps.

features.label: Export your data
features.definition: Export your data (CSV or similar).

features.label: Widgets
features.definition: Home Screen or Lock Screen widgets.

features.label: Live Activity
features.definition: Live Activity / Dynamic Island.

features.label: Siri & Shortcuts
features.definition: Siri or Shortcuts support.

features.label: Android
features.definition: An Android app.

features.label: Web app
features.definition: A web app.
